verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-facing bulk-operation capability, such as bulk-editing, bulk-deleting, or batch-applying changes across many sources, destinations, transformations or tracking-plan items. The nearest items are adjacent rather than direct: fan-out of a single deletion or consent change to many destinations, per-connection Reverse ETL sync triggering via API, and MCP-based duplicate detection, which is analysis rather than a bulk action. None of these meets the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
